Hidden transfer: the 18,000 General Fund payment to the Employee Reimbursement Fund is inside General Fund 2500 Central services 225,201 (p11) and eliminated on p8; split out in detail as an other financing item with the Reimbursement Fund showing +18,000, so detail ties to the statement's 226,668 Central services (207,201 + 19,467). General Fund expenditure total 5,509,164 includes the 110,400 transfer and the 18,000 hidden transfer (includes other financing). Items with no 2025 actual (budget-only lines: Depreciation transfer 349,079, Special Building spending, 3500 state categorical receipts, 9000 non-program) are not recorded. Employee Benefit and Special Building fund spending totals are blank on the pages.
